context: A boss reviews a regional incident
purpose: Teach: 北陸/音波/雑草/食用/耐性/重心/史実/過熱

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 北陸支店の水質トラブル、対応急げ。
lines.en: Get the Hokuriku branch water quality issue handled urgently.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Direct eye contact. No softening—this is an order, not a suggestion. Minimal air, economical delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。超音波検査機器、追加導入予定です。
lines.en: Understood. We're planning to bring in additional ultrasonic testing equipment.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact delivery. Shows competence without over-explaining. Slight nod forward. Measured pace—nothing rushed, nothing hesitant.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 敷地の雑草、計画的に管理しろ。
lines.en: Manage the site vegetation systematically. Don't let it get ahead of you.
lines.style: Firm directive. Weight on 'systematically'—this is about prevention, not reaction. Brief pause before the second sentence. Still composed, not harsh.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 食用油の取り扱い、安全基準も再確認します。
lines.en: We'll also review our safety protocols for edible oil handling.
lines.style: Measured, professional tone. Slight lean forward—showing initiative beyond what was asked. Calm, unhurried cadence. Demonstrates foresight without sounding defensive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 機械の耐性、テストで検証しろ。
lines.en: Run full testing to verify the machinery's durability under stress.
lines.style: Clear, unyielding instruction. Emphasis on 'full'—this can't be half-done. Slightly elevated energy from previous lines. No room for shortcuts.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 業界の重心、若手企業に移りつつあります。
lines.en: The industry's center of gravity is shifting toward younger companies.
lines.style: Thoughtful, observational tone. Slight distance—he's reflecting aloud, not just reporting. Pause before 'younger.' Lower energy than directive lines. A small moment of professional concern.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: Learn from what's happened before. History doesn't repeat, but it rhymes.
lines.style: Weighted, almost philosophical. Slow delivery on the first sentence. Pause between the two. Second line softer, more personal—wisdom, not mandate.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: メディア過熱、広報、慎重対応します。
lines.en: The media's been intense lately. We're handling press inquiries very carefully.
lines.style: Lower volume, closer to the listener. Controlled concern just beneath the surface. Steady tempo but deliberate. No panic—this is strategy, not crisis management.
